# FFmpeg WebAssembly

Unmodified `ffmpeg-core.js` and losslessly gzip-compressed `ffmpeg-core.wasm` from npm `@ffmpeg/core` version 0.12.10, single-thread UMD build. Distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later. The full GPL v2 text is included in LICENSE. The application-specific export-worker.js invokes this engine.

Project and corresponding source/build instructions: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.10
FFmpeg source and licenses: https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html

Before publishing or distributing this binary, provide the complete corresponding source and notices for the exact core build and its included codec libraries as required by its license. Do not treat these URLs alone as a substitute for the applicable source distribution requirements. Development only until that release review is complete.
